## Why it matters

Gujianzhu Wiki is a multilingual digital archive of Chinese historic architecture, connecting monuments such as the Yingxian Wooden Pagoda and the Mogao Caves with verified classical texts, inscriptions, and early photographs.

By tying each site to page-level provenance and primary sources, it helps researchers trace dispersed documentation of ancient architecture and grotto temples across periods and regions.
